title: The Hidden Cost of AI Reliance
summary: Examines the cognitive and skill-related costs of heavy LLM reliance, including skill atrophy, reduced critical thinking, hallucination risks, and long-term professional consequences despite short-term productivity gains.
when-to-read: Read this when evaluating how to integrate AI tools into your workflow without compromising your own technical growth and judgment. If you're looking for tactics to speed up specific coding tasks, consult documentation on particular AI tools instead; this article focuses on the strategic tradeoffs of dependence rather than tool capabilities.
